warnings: Slab sections joined to the plan slab marks S2 / S3 (both floor beam plans). Several layers per slab, so the bars are in bar_layers[] (section 0.6) with the printed text kept verbatim; unreadable digits are '?'.

The ground-floor plan marks the walkway bands S2 and also notes 'พื้นทางเท้า ค.ส.ล. (ดูแบบขยาย)' under the bottom walkway; the walkway detail prints Ø6 @0.25 while S2 prints Ø9 @0.20 + Ø6 @0.20. Both kept as printed; the plan's S2 marks are left on the walkway band (section 7: the detail is a separate unmarked element, recorded with element_id null).
The steel roof truss and the RC gable section of this sheet are in their own files (_view1 / _view4); the RC stair is in _view5_section_stair.json.
